title: He Does Not Get Out
hook: The Ledger is parked. Mya has the dash.
scene: Rain at midday, a downtown curb you can see from the mesh. The Ledger is parked where he knew you would look — destination sign dark, long-arm mirrors beaded. He does not get out. Mya is a brown mackerel loaf on the dash against the cargo wall, dark stripe, green eyes. The clipboard is on the doghouse between the seats. You idle in the Menace a stall away. Two engines. One cat. He waits for you to see what he already decided.
debrief: Deac came back parked, not walking. Mya has the glass because the bus is still. You took the look he waited for.

source.teaching_target: Deac returns: parked in sight, Mya on the dash only because the Ledger is still, he does not get out.

image_brief.subject: the Ledger parked, Deac in the high seat, Mya a brown mackerel loaf ON THE DASHBOARD INSIDE the cab, visible through the windshield, not on the hood
image_brief.foreground: Camera is inside the Menace, looking up at the interior rearview. Faded pink header, mesh dark around the glass.
image_brief.midground: in the rearview only: Ledger front fills the glass, door shut, Deac seated inside behind the wheel, Mya loafed on the dashboard INSIDE the cab against the cargo wall, clearly behind the windshield
image_brief.background: rain at midday, downtown brick in the reflection, nobody standing beside the bus
image_brief.read: Mya is on the Ledger's dashboard inside the cab; Deac is in the driver's seat; the door is shut
extra_negatives: no cat on any exterior surface
